SubLayerProcessing.SQLScript: SELECT alert_group_id, alert_group_code, alert_group_description, display_text, sort_order, is_active, hash(concat(IfNull(alert_group_id, ''), '|', IfNull(alert_group_code, ''), '|', IfNull(alert_group_description, ''), '|', IfNull(display_text, ''), '|', IfNull(sort_order, ''), '|', IfNull(is_active, false))) AS hash_key FROM (SELECT AlertGroupID AS alert_group_id, AlertGroupCode AS alert_group_code, AlertGroupDescription AS alert_group_description, DisplayText AS display_text, SortOrder AS sort_order, Active AS is_active FROM AlertGroup) a
SubLayerProcessing.MergeScript: MERGE INTO claimsprocessing.silver.silver_alertgroup t USING (SELECT * FROM tempSQLScript) s ON IfNull(s.alert_group_id, '') = IfNull(t.alert_group_id, '') WHEN MATCHED AND t.hash_key <> s.hash_key THEN UPDATE SET alert_group_id = s.alert_group_id, alert_group_code = s.alert_group_code, alert_group_description = s.alert_group_description, display_text = s.display_text, sort_order = s.sort_order, is_active = s.is_active, hash_key = s.hash_key WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (alert_group_id, alert_group_code, alert_group_description, display_text, sort_order, is_active, hash_key) VALUES (s.alert_group_id, s.alert_group_code, s.alert_group_description, s.display_text, s.sort_order, s.is_active, s.hash_key)
